purpose: Teach: 白色/股/壺/杭/便器/ふじ/カンガルー/凡人

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「白色の花が咲く季節だね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying something about how white flowers bloom this time of year.
lines.style: Warm, distant recollection. Soft pacing, like sharing something half-remembered. Voice carries affection for both Sho and his father. Slight smile implied.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに股関節のストレッチ法を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad taught me a hip stretch today.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride. Careful enunciation like he's being precise about something he learned. Quiet but present — the satisfaction of knowledge received and remembered.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「茶道で使う壺、つまり茶壺の話」を聞かせて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was telling me about tea jars — the kind used in tea ceremony.
lines.style: Same gentle recollection as before. Slightly more engaged now. The voice lingers on 'tea jars' like she's sharing something specific your father cared about explaining.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと公園の杭の場所を確認したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I checked where the stakes are in the park today.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, small-boy specificity. Confident in the action taken. No performance — just sharing what was done, quietly proud he was useful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「公衆便所、つまり便器の使い方マナー」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was explaining the proper manners for using public restrooms.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly amused. Like she's relaying something practical and very Sho's-father of him to explain. Warm without condescension.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと富士、つまりふじ山五合目に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad took me up to the fifth station of Mount Fuji.
lines.style: Clear, small voice carrying the weight of the achievement. Each word distinct — this matters. Quiet wonder underneath the simple recounting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「動物園のカンガルーは寝てる時間が長い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying how the kangaroos at the zoo sleep for such long stretches.
lines.style: Conversational, like she's continuing a thread. Light, almost gentle humor in the observation. The pacing suggests she's relaying something charming your father noticed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「凡人でも諦めなければ大丈夫」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad told me that even ordinary people can do great things if they don't give up.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. This is advice received and held close. Slow, considered delivery — the words matter. Voice steady, sincere, no lightness here.
